declaration.preface: At Riya Travels and Tours Pvt Ltd (Group), we uphold the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct in all aspects of our business. As a trusted leader in the travel industry, we are committed to fostering a culture of honesty, accountability, and fairness among our employees, partners, and stakeholders. Our Integrity and Ethics Policy serves as a guiding framework for ethical decision-making, ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements while promoting respect, inclusivity, and professionalism. We strictly prohibit corruption, bribery, and any form of unethical behavior, and we encourage open communication and responsible business practices. By adhering to these principles, we aim to build long-term trust with our customers and partners while maintaining our reputation as a responsible and ethical organization. This policy reinforces our commitment to ethical leadership, corporate responsibility, and a workplace culture that values integrity at every level of our operations.
declaration.declaration:
Foster a culture of integrity and responsible leadership across all levels of the organization.

Ensure compliance with local and international laws and regulations governing business operations.

I Strengthen data privacy and protect confidential information to maintain stakeholder trust.

Safeguard stakeholder interests by ensuring responsible governance and risk management.

Prevent corruption, bribery, and conflicts of interest through strong internal controls and compliance mechanisms.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct in all business operations and decision-making processes.

Establish a whistleblower mechanism to enable employees and stakeholders to report unethical behavior without fear of retaliation.
declaration.scope: This Integrity and Ethics Policy is applicable across all operations, business functions, and services of Riya Travel and Tours (India) Pvt Ltd (Group), covering all global locations, including corporate offices, registered offices, branch locations, subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associated supply chain activities. It applies to all employees, workers, contractors, and stakeholders connected to Riya Travel and Tours (India) Pvt Ltd (Group), whether directly or indirectly, and mandates strict adherence and accountability at every level.

focusAreas: Ensuring transparency, accountability, and integrity in all business operations.
Upholding ethical business practices and preventing corruption, bribery, and conflicts of interest.
Strengthening internal controls and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Promoting responsible decision-making at all levels of the organization.
Safeguarding data privacy and protecting confidential information.
Establishing clear guidelines for whistleblowing and addressing grievances.
Ensuring diversity and inclusion in leadership and decision-making processes.

Integrity-Driven Anti-Corruption Measure: Employees will be provided with clear guidelines on ethical decision-making and how to report corruption-related concerns without fear of retaliation.
Managing Conflicts of Interest: We will establish clear conflict of interest guidelines to ensure transparent decision-making, requiring 100% of employees to disclose potential conflicts and adhere to ethical standards.
Fraud Prevention: We will implement a confidential whistleblowing mechanism to enable employees to report suspected fraud without fear.
Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance: A comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policy will be implemented.
Information Security: We will implement multi-layered security measures, including encryption and access controls, to safeguard critical business information.
We aim to conduct periodic internal and external audits of our information security systems to identify and resolve vulnerabilities.
We plan to develop an incident response plan to effectively manage and mitigate security breaches.
Disciplinary Measures for Violations: To maintain integrity, violations of the Ethics Policy will be addressed through a structured disciplinary framework:

Disciplinary Action: Employees found violating this policy will be subject to disciplinary measures, including formal warnings, suspension, or termination of employment, depending on the severity of the breach.

Legal Action: Violations involving corruption, fraud, bribery, or money laundering may lead to legal action, including criminal prosecution and financial penalties, as per applicable local and international laws.
Contract Termination: Business partners, suppliers, or contractors found in breach of this policy may face contract termination and removal from the company’s approved supplier list.
Financial Penalties: Any financial loss incurred due to a breach of policy may be recovered from the responsible individuals or entities.
Loss of Business Privileges: Individuals or entities involved in unethical behavior may face suspension or permanent loss of business privileges with Riya Travels and Tours Group.

Reputation Damage and Corrective Action: Any damage to the company’s reputation due to unethical behavior will require corrective actions, including public disclosure and engagement with affected stakeholders.

Whistleblower Protection and Investigation: All reports of policy violations will be promptly investigated under strict confidentiality. Retaliation against whistleblowers is strictly prohibited, and any such act will result in disciplinary action.
Mandatory Retraining: Employees or partners found violating the policy may be required to undergo mandatory retraining on the company’s Integrity and Ethics Policy to prevent recurrence.
Guidelines for Employees: All employees, including those directly or indirectly associated with Riya Travels and Tours Pvt Ltd (Group), are expected to uphold the company’s core values of integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct. The following guidelines outline the expected standards of behavior and responsibility:
Always be honest, respectful, and professional in all business dealings.
Communicate clearly and truthfully with clients, colleagues, and partners.
Treat all clients and colleagues with courtesy and professionalism, even in challenging situations.
Avoid gossip, negative talk, and unprofessional language within the workplace.
Respond to client complaints promptly and professionally, aiming to resolve issues fairly.
Avoid situations where personal interests could affect business decisions.
Disclose any personal relationships or financial interests that may create a conflict.
Do not use your position to benefit yourself, family, or friends at the company's expense.
Keep client and company information private and secure.
Do not share sensitive information with outsiders.
Ensure that confidential documents are stored securely and accessed only by authorized personnel.
Destroy sensitive data responsibly when it is no longer needed.
Do not offer or accept bribes, gifts, or favors to influence business decisions.
Follow company guidelines on acceptable gifts and hospitality.
Avoid any financial transactions that could be perceived as bribery.
Report any attempts of bribery or corruption to the compliance team immediately.
Be clear and honest about service charges and terms with clients.
Do not hide costs or mislead clients.
Ensure that all contracts and agreements are written clearly and follow company policies.
Avoid unfair competition or misleading advertising about company services.
Report any unethical behavior or policy violations to the company.
You will be protected from retaliation if you report honestly.
Ensure that whistleblowing reports are handled confidentially and fairly.
Ensure that all financial transactions are accurate and properly documented.
Do not submit false or misleading financial information.
Expense claims must be accurate and supported by valid documentation.
Report any suspicious financial activity to the finance or compliance team.
Treat clients and suppliers fairly and professionally.
Select suppliers based on quality and value, not personal connections.
Do not engage in side deals or private agreements with suppliers.
Ensure that supplier contracts comply with company policies and legal requirements.
Follow all applicable local and international laws.
Report any illegal or non-compliant activity immediately.
Stay informed about changes in laws and regulations that affect business operations.

policy.monitoring:
The governance of this Integrity and Ethics Policy will be overseen by the Ethics and Compliance Officer. This individual will be responsible for ensuring adherence to ethical standards, monitoring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, and addressing any ethical concerns within the organization. They will work closely with all departments to promote a culture of integrity, provide training on ethical conduct, and facilitate open communication regarding ethical dilemmas. Regular audits, reporting mechanisms, and policy updates will be conducted to maintain transparency and accountability. The Ethics and Compliance Officer will ensure that ethical principles remain central to corporate decision-making and business operations.

The Ethics and Compliance Officer will submit quarterly reports on policy adherence, ethical concerns, and corrective measures taken.

HR and department heads will provide updates on ethical training, employee concerns, and policy improvements.

Regular audits will be conducted to identify potential ethical risks and non-compliance issues.

Any ethical violations will be documented, investigated, and addressed promptly.

An annual Ethics and Compliance Report will be published to highlight the company’s commitment to integrity and transparency.

Reports will be shared with regulatory bodies, stakeholders, and business partners as required.

A confidential reporting channel will be available for employees and stakeholders to report ethical concerns.

Feedback will be reviewed regularly to enhance the effectiveness of the policy.

We are committed to continuously strengthening our integrity and ethical standards. Our policies and ethical guidelines will be regularly assessed to incorporate best practices, legal updates, and stakeholder expectations. Through ongoing ethics training, enhanced reporting mechanisms, and a culture of accountability, we will ensure ethical conduct remains a core pillar of our business operations.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Ethics and Compliance Officer will review this policy every year or as needed to ensure it remains effective and up to date. In collaboration with senior management and relevant stakeholders, they will monitor adherence, address emerging ethical challenges, and refine policies to align with evolving legal and corporate governance requirements. Necessary adjustments will be implemented to maintain transparency, fairness, and integrity across all business operations.
